mapper.select: SELECT operation_id,request_sha256,state,http_status,response_ref,target_id,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256 FROM operation_record WHERE subject_id=#{userId} AND operation_name=#{operationName} AND idempotency_key=#{key} FOR UPDATE
SELECT run_id FROM task_active_run WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND task_id=#{taskId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT CAST(attempt_no AS CHAR) FROM task_run WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND task_id=#{taskId} ORDER BY created_at DESC,run_id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT JSON_OBJECT('tenant_id',b.tenant_id,'project_id',b.project_id,'budget_id',b.budget_id, 'budget_revision',r.budget_revision,'current_budget_revision',b.current_budget_revision,'currency',r.currency,'account_currency',b.currency, 'spent',CAST(b.spent AS CHAR),'reserved',CAST(b.reserved AS CHAR),'spent_tokens',CAST(b.spent_tokens AS CHAR), 'reserved_tokens',CAST(b.reserved_tokens AS CHAR),'spent_calls',CAST(b.spent_calls AS CHAR),'reserved_calls',CAST(b.reserved_calls AS CHAR), 'approval',r.limits,'approver_id',r.approver_id,'reason',r.reason,'content_sha256',r.content_sha256,'registry_sha256',v.content_sha256, 'schema_version',r.schema_version,'schema_manifest',r.schema_manifest_sha256) FROM budget_revision r JOIN budget_account b ON b.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND b.budget_id=r.budget_id AND b.project_id <=> r.project_id JOIN version_registry v ON v.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND v.version_id=r.budget_revision AND v.entity_kind='BUDGET' AND v.owner_project_id <=> r.project_id WHERE r.budget_revision=#{budgetRevision} FOR UPDATE

SELECT JSON_OBJECT('run_id',r.run_id,'task_id',r.task_id,'task_revision',r.task_revision,'budget_revision',r.budget_revision, 'plan_revision',tr.plan_revision,'snapshot_id',tr.snapshot_id,'agent_release_id',tr.agent_release_id, 'replay_manifest',r.replay_manifest,'scope_manifest',e.scope_manifest,'principal_manifest',p.capability_manifest, 'created_by',r.created_by,'schema_manifest',r.schema_manifest_sha256, 'command',o.payload,'retention_policy_revision',s.retention_policy_revision) FROM task_run r JOIN task_revision tr ON tr.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND tr.project_id=r.project_id AND tr.task_id=r.task_id AND tr.task_revision=r.task_revision JOIN execution_registry e ON e.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND e.project_id=r.project_id AND e.run_id=r.run_id JOIN run_principal p ON p.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND p.project_id=r.project_id AND p.run_id=r.run_id AND p.initiator_id=r.created_by JOIN stream_registry s ON s.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND s.project_id=r.project_id AND s.kind='RUN' AND s.owner_resource_id=r.run_id JOIN outbox_event o ON o.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND o.aggregate_id=r.run_id AND o.event_type='run.start.requested' AND o.payload->>'$.command.command_id'=#{commandId} WHERE r.project_id=#{projectId} AND r.task_id=#{taskId} AND r.run_id=#{runId} AND r.execution_kind='TASK' AND e.execution_kind='TASK' AND r.workflow_id=CONCAT(r.tenant_id,'/',r.run_id) FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE task_head SET status='READY',revision=revision+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND task_id=#{taskId} AND current_revision=#{taskRevision} AND revision=#{expectedRevision} AND status=#{expectedStatus}
